MADSCIENTIST-MIXED_REAGENT.description: Deal {Damage} damage. Draw {Cards} cards. Apply {WeakPower} Weak. Apply {PoisonPower} Poison.
MADSCIENTIST-KNOCK.title: Knock
MADSCIENTIST-KNOCK.description: Deal {Damage} damage to ALL enemies. Give ALL enemies 1 Buffer.
MADSCIENTIST-BLAST.title: Blast
MADSCIENTIST-BLAST.description: Deal {Damage} damage. Apply {VulnerablePower} Vulnerable. Apply {WeakPower} Weak.
MADSCIENTIST-MACHINE_BLAST.title: Machine Blast
MADSCIENTIST-MACHINE_BLAST.description: Deal {Damage} damage. Apply {VulnerablePower} Vulnerable. Apply {WeakPower} Weak. Consume 5 Machine Durability.
MADSCIENTIST-MACHINE_REAGENT.title: Machine Reagent
MADSCIENTIST-MACHINE_REAGENT.description: Deal {Damage} damage. Draw {Cards} cards. Apply {WeakPower} Weak. Apply {PoisonPower} Poison. Consume 5 Machine Durability.
MADSCIENTIST-SPATIAL_TEAR.title: Spatial Tear
MADSCIENTIST-SPATIAL_TEAR.description: Deal {Damage} damage once for each enemy.
MADSCIENTIST-GIANT_WRENCH.title: Giant Wrench
MADSCIENTIST-GIANT_WRENCH.description: Deal {Damage} damage. If this kills, Repair 10.
MADSCIENTIST-CHEMICAL_FOG.title: Chemical Fog
MADSCIENTIST-CHEMICAL_FOG.description: Lose {Loss} Dexterity. Lose {Loss} Strength. Gain {Block} Block.
MADSCIENTIST-OBSESSION.title: Obsession
MADSCIENTIST-OBSESSION.description: While in your hand, you cannot play Skills other than Obsession. Gain {Block} Block.
MADSCIENTIST-BENEFICIAL_MUTATION.title: Beneficial Mutation
MADSCIENTIST-SELF_REVIEW.title: Self-Review
MADSCIENTIST-SELF_REVIEW.description: Gain 1 Buffer. If you have more than 5 Buffer, heal 3 HP.
MADSCIENTIST-ETHICAL_BOUNDARY.title: Ethical Boundary
MADSCIENTIST-ETHICAL_BOUNDARY.descriptio: Gain {Energy} Energy. Draw {Cards} cards. Add a Guilt into your draw pile, and another Guilt into your deck after combat.
MADSCIENTIST-FORBIDDEN_FRENZY.title: Forbidden Frenzy
MADSCIENTIST-FORBIDDEN_FRENZY.descriptio: Can only be played while Machine Durability is exactly 10. Deal {Damage} damage to ALL enemies. Repair 3.
MADSCIENTIST-INFINITE_MACHINE_RESEARCH.d: Your machine no longer loses durability.
MADSCIENTIST-SCIENTIFIC_METHOD.title: Scientific Method
MADSCIENTIST-FUSED_CARD.title: Fusion
MADSCIENTIST-SCIENTIFIC_LEGACY.title: Scientific Legacy
MADSCIENTIST-SCIENTIFIC_LEGACY.descripti: Choose 1 of 9 Mad Science cards and add it to your hand.
MADSCIENTIST-GREAT_FUSION.title: Great Fusion
MADSCIENTIST-GREAT_FUSION.description: {IfUpgraded:show:Before fusing, upgrade every card that will be fused. Then fuse all other cards in your hand into this card and auto-play the fused card.|Fuse all other cards in your hand into this card, then auto-play the fused card.}
MADSCIENTIST-ASSEMBLE.title: Assemble
MADSCIENTIST-ASSEMBLE.description: Fuse all Unplayable cards in your hand and draw pile with this card.
MADSCIENTIST-FULLY_AUTOMATIC.title: Fully Automatic
MADSCIENTIST-FULLY_AUTOMATIC.description: Consume all your Machine Durability and deal that much damage to ALL enemies. Repair {Repair} for each enemy hit. At the start of your turn, if this is in your exhaust pile, auto-play it.
MADSCIENTIST-MACHINE_RUMBLE.title: Machine Rumble
MADSCIENTIST-MACHINE_RUMBLE.description: Deal {Damage} damage twice. Consume 5 Machine Durability.
MADSCIENTIST-UNIVERSAL_CORRECTION.title: Universal Correction
MADSCIENTIST-UNIVERSAL_CORRECTION.descri: Deal damage equal to the enemy's current HP modulo {IfUpgraded:show:40|20}.
MADSCIENTIST-DEFENSE_MODULE.title: Defense Module
MADSCIENTIST-DEFENSE_MODULE.description: When fused, the fused card gains 8 Block when played.
MADSCIENTIST-SPEED_MODULE.title: Speed Module
MADSCIENTIST-SPEED_MODULE.description: When fused, the fused card draws 3 cards when played.
MADSCIENTIST-ENERGY_MODULE.title: Energy Module
MADSCIENTIST-ENERGY_MODULE.description: When fused, the fused card gains 2 Energy when played.
MADSCIENTIST-ATTACK_MODULE.title: Attack Module
MADSCIENTIST-ATTACK_MODULE.description: If fused with exactly 1 other Attack, the fused card gains Replay 1.
MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST_CHARACTER_CAR: Choose 3 of 9 Mad Science cards. Gain {Energy} Energy.
MADSCIENTIST-LOSS_OF_SANITY.title: Loss of Sanity
MADSCIENTIST-LOSS_OF_SANITY.description: Gain 99 Frail and 99 Vulnerable{IfUpgraded:show:| and 99 Weak}. Permanently remove a card from your deck.
MADSCIENTIST-X_RAY.title: X-Ray
MADSCIENTIST-X_RAY.description: Deal 10 damage to ALL enemies {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} times. For the next {IfUpgraded:show:X-1|X} turns, you cannot gain Block from cards.
MADSCIENTIST-BLASTING_DEVICE.title: Blasting Device
MADSCIENTIST-BLASTING_DEVICE.description: Add {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} Blast cards into your hand. This turn, your Blast cards cost 0.
MADSCIENTIST-PSEUDOSCIENTIFIC_METHOD.des: Fuse up to 4 cards in your hand.
MADSCIENTIST-MUTATION.title: Mutation
MADSCIENTIST-MUTATION.description: Gain {Block} Block. Gain 1 Strength. Next turn, lose {Loss} Dexterity.
MADSCIENTIST-SCORCHED_GROUND.title: Scorched Ground
MADSCIENTIST-SCORCHED_GROUND.description: At the start of the next {Turns} turns, deal 8 damage to a random enemy.
MADSCIENTIST-THINK.title: Think
MADSCIENTIST-THINK.description: At the start of your next turn, gain {Block} Block and 2 Energy.
MADSCIENTIST-MECHANICAL_ASCENSION.title: Mechanical Ascension
MADSCIENTIST-MECHANICAL_ASCENSION.descri: Gain {Artifact} Artifact. Exhaust all Power cards in your draw pile, discard pile and hand.
MADSCIENTIST-REPTILIAN_EVOLUTION_PROJECT: Gain {Intangible} Intangible. Exhaust all Power cards in your draw pile, discard pile and hand.
MADSCIENTIST-FORBIDDEN_SCIENCE.title: Forbidden Science
MADSCIENTIST-FORBIDDEN_SCIENCE.descripti: When fused, the fused card costs 0 and deals 15 damage to ALL enemies when played.
MADSCIENTIST-SCIENTIFIC_RESEARCH.title: Scientific Research
MADSCIENTIST-SCIENTIFIC_RESEARCH.descrip: When drawn, add a copy of this card into your hand. When played, gain {Block} Block and Repair {Repair}.
MADSCIENTIST-PROCESS.title: Process
MADSCIENTIST-PROCESS.description: Exhaust 1 card in your hand, draw 1 card, and fuse it with this card.
MADSCIENTIST-INVENTORY.title: Inventory
MADSCIENTIST-INVENTORY.description: At the start of your turn, choose up to {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} cards from your discard pile and put them into your hand.
MADSCIENTIST-MAD_RESEARCH.title: Mad Research
MADSCIENTIST-MAD_RESEARCH.description: At the start of each turn, gain a random uncommon Power card.
MADSCIENTIST-SOUL_RESEARCH.title: Soul Research
MADSCIENTIST-SOUL_RESEARCH.description: The next time you would die, lose {IfUpgraded:show:3|5} Max HP and heal to half your Max HP.
MADSCIENTIST-REFINE.title: Refine
MADSCIENTIST-REFINE.description: When played, gain an extra potion identical to your leftmost potion at the end of this combat.
MADSCIENTIST-SPARE_SPIKES.title: Spare Spikes
MADSCIENTIST-SPARE_SPIKES.description: At the start of your next turn, deal {DelayedDamage} damage to ALL enemies.
MADSCIENTIST-SPARE_REAGENT.title: Spare Reagent
MADSCIENTIST-SPARE_REAGENT.description: At the start of your next turn, deal {DelayedDamage} damage to ALL enemies and apply {Weak} Weak.
MADSCIENTIST-PLAN.title: Plan
MADSCIENTIST-PLAN.description: Gain {Block} Block. At the start of your next turn, Repair 3.
MADSCIENTIST-SELF_REPAIR_RESEARCH.title: Self-Repair Research
MADSCIENTIST-SELF_REPAIR_RESEARCH.descri: At the start of each turn, Repair {Repair}.
